question: Which of the following options is NOT a correct trigonometric identity?
options:
1 + cot2 \(\theta\) = cosec² \(\theta\)

1 + tan2 \(\theta\) = sec2 \(\theta\)

1 - sin2 \(\theta\) = cos2 \(\theta\)

cos2\(\theta\) - sin2 \(\theta\) - 1
solution:
The correct answer is option 4 i.e. cos2\(\theta\) - sin2 \(\theta\) - 1

As we know

The identity in the trigonometry

sin2 \(\theta\) + cos2 \(\theta\) = 1

 1 - sin2 \(\theta\) = cos2 \(\theta\) [ Option 3 is correct identity]

sec2 \(\theta\)  - tan2 \(\theta\) = 1 

 1 + tan2 \(\theta\) = sec2 \(\theta\) [ Option 2 is correct identity]

cosec²  \(\theta\) - cot2 \(\theta\) = 1

 1 + cot2 \(\theta\) = cosec²  \(\theta\) [ Option 1 is correct identity]

Hence, Option 4 i.e. cos2\(\theta\) - sin2 \(\theta\) - 1 is not correct identity

question: Find the value of \(\sqrt{\frac{1-sin 3\theta }{1+sin 3\theta }}\)
solution:
The correct answer is option 1 i.e.  sec 3θ-tan 3θ.

\(\sqrt{\frac{1-sin 3\theta }{1+sin 3\theta }}\)

put θ = 15°

= \(\sqrt{\frac{1-sin (3\times15) }{1+sin (3\times 15) }}\)

= \(\sqrt{\frac{1-sin 45^o }{1+sin 45^o }}\)

= \(\sqrt{\frac{1-(1/\sqrt2) }{1+(1/\sqrt2)}}\)  = \(\sqrt{\frac{\sqrt2 -1 }{\sqrt2 +1}}\) = \(\sqrt{\frac{(\sqrt2 -1)(\sqrt2 -1) }{(\sqrt2 +1)(\sqrt2 -1)}}\) = \(\sqrt2 -1\)

Now, we check the option 1 :  sec 3θ - tan 3θ 

Put θ = 15°

= sec (3 × 15)° - tan (3 × 15)°

= sec 45° - tan 45°

=  \(\sqrt2 -1\)

Hence, sec 3θ - tan 3θ is the correct answer

question: A vertical pole of 28 m in height casts a 19.2 m long shadow. At the same time, find the length of the shadow cast by another pole of 52.5 m in height.
solution:
The correct answer is option 1 i.e. 36 cm.

Given that

A vertical pole of 28 m in height casts a 19.2 m-long shadow.

The height of another pole = 52.5 m

Let the length of the shadow of another pole be L

According to the question

L/52.5 = 19.2/28

L = 19.2 × 52.5/28 = 36 cm

दिया गया हैं कि

28 मीटर ऊंचे एक ऊर्ध्वाधर खंभे की छाया 19.2 मीटर लंबी है।

दूसरे खंभे की ऊँचाई = 52.5 मीटर

माना दूसरे खंभे की छाया की लंबाई L है

प्रश्न के अनुसार

L/52.5 = 19.2/28

L = 19.2 × 52.5/28 = 36 सेमी

question: If \(\left ( \frac{cosA}{1-sinA} \right )+\left ( \frac{cosA}{1+sinA} \right )=4\), then what will be the value of A? (0° < θ < 90°)
solution:
The correct answer is option 3 i.e. 60°

Given that

If \(\left ( \frac{cosA}{1-sinA} \right )+\left ( \frac{cosA}{1+sinA} \right )=4\),

⇒ \(\left (\frac{cosA(1+sinA) + cos A(1 - sinA)}{1-sin^2A} \right )=4\)

⇒ \(\left (\frac{cosA+cosAsinA + cos A -cosA sinA}{cos^2A} \right )=4\)

⇒ 2/cosA = 4

⇒ cos A = 1/2 = cos 60°

⇒ A = 60°

question: If \(\frac{sinx-cosx}{sinx+cosx}=\frac{2}{5}\), then the value of \(\frac{1+cot^2x}{1-cot^2x}\)?
solution:
The correct answer is option 2 i.e. 1.45.

Given that

If \(\frac{sinx-cosx}{sinx+cosx}=\frac{2}{5}\),

Caculation

⇒ \(\frac{sinx(1-cotx)}{sinx(1+cotx)}=\frac{2}{5}\)

⇒ \(\frac{(1-cotx)}{(1+cotx)}=\frac{2}{5}\)

⇒ 5 - 5 cotx = 2 + 2 cotx

⇒ 7 cotx = 3

⇒ cotx = 3/7

Hence, the value \(\frac{1+cot^2x}{1-cot^2x}\) = \(\frac{1+9/49}{1-9/49}\) = 58/40 = 1.45

question: Using tan (A - B) = \(\frac{tanA-tanB}{1+tanA tanB}\) find the value of tan15º.
solution:
The correct answer is Option 3 i.e. 2 - √3.

tan15º = tan(45º - 30º)

Using tan (A - B) = \(\frac{tanA-tanB}{1+tanA tanB}\) 

⇒ \(tan(45º - 30º) = \frac{tan45º-tan30º}{1+tan45º tan30º}\)

⇒ \(tan15º = \frac{1-{1\over{\sqrt3}}}{1+1\times{1\over{\sqrt3}}}\)

⇒ \(tan15º = \frac{{\sqrt3-1\over{\sqrt3}}}{{\sqrt3+1\over{\sqrt3}}}\)

⇒ \(tan15º = \frac{{\sqrt3-1}}{{\sqrt3+1} }​​\)

On rationalizing,

⇒ \(tan15º = {{{\sqrt3-1}}\over{{\sqrt3+1}}}\times{{{\sqrt3-1}}\over{{\sqrt3-1}}}\)

⇒ \(tan15º = {{{{(\sqrt3}-1})^2}\over{{\sqrt3^2-1^2}}}\)

⇒ \(tan15º = {{{{\sqrt3^2}+1^2-2\times\sqrt3}}\over{{3-1}}}\)

⇒ \(tan15º = {{{{3}+1-2\sqrt3}}\over{{2}}}\)

⇒ \(tan15º = {{{4-2\sqrt3}}\over{{2}}}\)

⇒ \(tan15º = {{{2(2-\sqrt3)}}\over{{2}}}\)

⇒ \(tan15º = (2-\sqrt3)\)

solution_hi:
सही उत्तर विकल्प 3 अर्थात् 2 - √3 है।

tan15º = tan(45º - 30º)

tan (A - B) = \(\frac{tanA-tanB}{1+tanA tanB}\) का प्रयोग करके

⇒ \(tan(45º - 30º) = \frac{tan45º-tan30º}{1+tan45º tan30º}\)

⇒ \(tan15º = \frac{1-{1\over{\sqrt3}}}{1+1\times{1\over{\sqrt3}}}\)

⇒ \(tan15º = \frac{{\sqrt3-1\over{\sqrt3}}}{{\sqrt3+1\over{\sqrt3}}}\)

⇒ \(tan15º = \frac{{\sqrt3-1}}{{\sqrt3+1} }​​\)

परिमेयकरण करने पर,

⇒ \(tan15º = {{{\sqrt3-1}}\over{{\sqrt3+1}}}\times{{{\sqrt3-1}}\over{{\sqrt3-1}}}\)

⇒ \(tan15º = {{{{(\sqrt3}-1})^2}\over{{\sqrt3^2-1^2}}}\)

⇒ \(tan15º = {{{{\sqrt3^2}+1^2-2\times\sqrt3}}\over{{3-1}}}\)

⇒ \(tan15º = (2-\sqrt3)\)

question: Find the exact value of cos 120°.
solution:
The correct answer is Option 1 i.e. -0.5.

cos 120° lies in the second quadrant,

We know that in the second quadrant, only sin and cosec are positive rather and all other trigonometric functions are negative

Thus, cos120° = cos(180° - 60°) = cos(-60°) = -1/2 = -0.5
question_hi: cos 120° का सटीक मान ज्ञात कीजिए।
solution_hi:
सही उत्तर विकल्प 1 अर्थात् -0.5 है।

cos 120° दूसरे चतुर्थांश में स्थित है,

हम जानते हैं कि दूसरे चतुर्थांश में, केवल sin और cosec धनात्मक होते हैं और अन्य सभी त्रिकोणमितीय फलन ऋणात्मक होते हैं

इस प्रकार, cos120° = cos(180° - 60°) = cos(-60°) = -1/2 = -0.5

question: Using cot(A - B) \(=\frac{cotAcotB+1}{cotB-cotA}\), find the value of cot15°.
solution:
The correct answer is Option 1 i.e. \(2+\sqrt{3}\).

cot(A - B) \(=\frac{cotAcotB+1}{cotB-cotA}\) 

⇒ cot 15° = cot (45° - 30°)

⇒ cot (45° - 30°) \(=\frac{cot45°cot30°+1}{cot30°-cot45°}\)

⇒ cot 15° \(=\frac{(1)(\sqrt3)+1}{(\sqrt3)-(1)}\)

⇒ cot 15° \(={\frac{(\sqrt3)+1}{(\sqrt3)-(1)}} \times {\frac{(\sqrt3)+1}{(\sqrt3)+(1)}} \)

⇒ cot 15° \(=\frac {(\sqrt3 + 1)^2}{(\sqrt3)^2 - 1^2}\)

⇒ cot 15° \(=\frac {3 + 1 + 2\sqrt3}{3 - 1}\)

⇒ cot 15° \(=\frac {4 + 2\sqrt3}{2}\)

⇒ cot 15° \(=\frac {2(2 + \sqrt3)}{{2}}\)

⇒ cot 15° \(={(2 + \sqrt3)} \)

question: If \(sec\theta=\frac{4}{3}\), what is the value of tan2θ + tan4θ?

the value of tan2θ + tan4θ
